economic_rationale: TA-Lib-default CCI14 scales current completed-day typical-price displacement by recent mean absolute deviation. It is valuable only if conventional positive/negative 100 hysteresis retains material upside after costs, lowers drawdown, improves Calmar, survives annual breadth and remains stable at frozen symmetric 75 and 125 neighbors. Reduced exposure or a normalized oscillator alone cannot pass.
opportunity_cost: One exact historical decision is cheaper and more informative than waiting ninety days or adding another source adapter. A failure permanently closes this CCI14 symmetric 75/100/125 hysteresis family without period, formula, threshold, state, timing or parent changes.
stop_conditions: Stop with DATA_REJECT before economics if any source hash, dataset hash, hourly lattice, OHLCV, complete UTC-day or CCI arithmetic gate fails.
Stop with EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT before economics if TA-Lib typical-price, mean-deviation, zero-deviation or next-open availability is ambiguous.
Stop and permanently close the exact CCI14 symmetric 75/100/125 hysteresis family if the primary or either rejection-only neighbor fails any frozen gate.
Do not select a neighbor after seeing outcomes even if it outperforms the primary.

Do not scan another CCI period, price source, scaling constant, threshold, equality, asymmetric boundary, initial state, confirmation, delay, holding period, stop, DRA combination or cost model after results.
Do not use post-2024 data; a pass may only become CANDIDATE_FROZEN_REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED with one independent sealed OOS still required.
thesis: When completed-day BTC typical price exceeds its recent mean by more than the conventional CCI dispersion band, a causal next-open long state held until the symmetric negative extreme may retain directional upside while avoiding enough sustained adverse paths to improve fee-adjusted risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold.

distinct_from_closed_families: Unlike the closed Bollinger family, CCI14 uses mean absolute deviation of typical price and follows positive displacement with symmetric hysteresis rather than buying a lower standard-deviation band for mean reversion.
Unlike the closed RSI, Stochastic and Aroon families, CCI is not a gain-loss ratio, range-location transform or extreme-recency clock.
Unlike the closed MFI and OBV families, CCI uses no volume or signed-volume accumulation.
Unlike a simple price-above-SMA state, conventional positive/negative 100 hysteresis preserves normalized displacement magnitude and prior state.
excluded_reinterpretations: Symmetric positive/negative 100 is primary; 75 and 125 are rejection-only neighbors and cannot replace it.

No alternate period, typical-price definition, divisor, threshold, asymmetric boundary, equality, initial state, confirmation, delay, hold, stop, leverage, short leg, DRA interaction or ensemble may be scanned after outcome access.
A historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and still requires one independent sealed OOS.
